test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average weight of 14 persons out of 16 persons is 75 kg. The total weight of the remaining two persons is 48 kg more than the average weight of all 16 persons. Find the average weight of the remaining two persons.
solution:
**Given:**

Average weight of 14 persons = 75 kg

Total weight of 14 persons = 14 × 75 = 1050 kg

Total weight of all 16 persons = Total weight of 14 persons + Total weight of remaining 2 persons

The total weight of the remaining two persons is 48 kg more than the average weight of all 16 persons.

Calculations:

Let the average weight of all 16 persons be x.

Total weight of all 16 persons = 16 × x = 16x

Total weight of the remaining two persons = 16x - 1050

We are given that the total weight of the remaining two persons is 48 kg more than the average weight of all 16 persons, so:

16x - 1050 = x + 48

⇒ 16x - x = 1050 + 48

⇒ 15x = 1098

⇒ x = 1098 / 15 = 73.2 kg

The average weight of all 16 persons is 73.2 kg. Now, the total weight of the remaining two persons is:

Remaining two persons' total weight = 16 × 73.2 - 1050 = 1171.2 - 1050 = 121.2 kg

The average weight of the remaining two persons = 121.2 / 2 = 60.6 kg

**∴ The average weight of the remaining two persons is 60.6 kg.**
